badge.noProof: it came without proof from its domain
badge.claims: It says it is from {domain}. Nothing can be sent back until that checks out.

settings.enabledDesc: Let organisations ask to see your skills, invite you to assessments and interviews, and send you offers.
settings.off: Requests from organisations are off. This device doesn't contact Alexandria Cloud for them.
settings.noCloud: No Alexandria Cloud is set up for this network yet, so organisations can't reach you here.
settings.noCloudDev: Developers can point the app at one in the Developer settings.
settings.cloudDesc: Use a different Alexandria Cloud, such as one running locally. Leave empty for the network's own.
settings.panelDesc: Paste the join link the organisation sent you. It opens your seat on the panel.

requests.title: Requests
requests.note: Organisations reach you through Alexandria Cloud. Each one proves who it is with a record in its own domain's DNS, and you can only answer those that do.

access.syncNote: Keeping in sync sends them an updated copy whenever these skills change, until you stop sharing.
access.notNowNote: Not now hides this until you restart the app. They are not told.
access.sharedSync: Shared with {org}. It will be kept up to date.

assessment.noCredentials: No matching credential yet. If they asked for a new assessment, take it from this request.
assessment.disclosure: This sends the whole credential you chose, including its integrity summary, to this organisation only. It does not publish your listing or send any raw monitoring captures.

interview.toBeArranged: To be arranged by the organisation
interview.integrityAsked: They ask you to run Alexandria's integrity check during the call. You decide when you join, and you can say no.

access.title: Who has access
access.note: Organisations you have shared skills with. They see only the skills listed, and you can stop sharing at any time.
access.empty: You haven't shared your skills with any organisation.
access.viewed: Viewed once · last {date} | Viewed {count} times · last {date}
access.stopMessage: {org} will no longer see these skills. Alexandria Cloud deletes what it holds for them.

visibility.heading: Institutions that can see you by name
visibility.empty: No institution has been given this.
visibility.note: Instructors see the learners in modules they teach either way — that is how somebody who is struggling gets help. This is about administrators, who otherwise see only counts. It ends by itself when your enrolment does.
visibility.on: Administrators at {institution} can see your named outcomes

views.heading: Recent views
views.aggregate: {where} counted you in a report that named nobody

problems.heading: Couldn't check
problems.note: A check that failed is shown rather than skipped — otherwise it would look the same as having nothing to report.

listing.framing: Saving only records these choices. Nothing is sent until you publish, or turn on keeping your listing up to date.
listing.heading: Your listing
listing.nothingToPublish: Choose at least one skill and save before publishing.
listing.keepUpToDate: Keep my listing up to date
listing.keepNote: Republishes your listing automatically whenever your chosen skills change.
